以 PKG_ 开头的条目是本方案自建的闸门，不是组织方检查项，不参与 ok / can_enter_formal_review 的判定。**它们只可能记录『通过』**——任一闸门不过，构建即停止，包不会存在，因此『通过』二字本身不构成证据。有证据价值的是每条 message 里的读数：它可以拿随包产物直接复核。（本次记录 26 道闸门，逐道由构建的输出现取，而不是从一份手写名单里挑——名单曾经只列了 7 道。）

forward_reference_qa.py — forward references: every numbered rule is defined before it is cited, and the definitions run in order

gate_mutation_qa.py — gate mutation: 43 deliberate defects across 23 of 26 gates, all caught and all named by the gate that caught them; 3 gates not yet proven able to fail, each with its reason published
intake_limits_qa.py — intake limits: 44 shipped Markdown and JSON files within the organisers' caps; the tightest is proposal.en.md with 53 bytes to spare
markdown_structure_qa.py — markdown structure: 104 tables across both editions, every separator and row matching its header, every ordered list strictly increasing

三张矩阵的引用是否解析且指向对的小节 — matrix references: 526 declared across three matrices, 526 of them resolved against headings, shipped files or the file that defines the id; every requirement whose title names a heading cites that heading; 17 class-1 metrics, every one recomputed by the shipped verifier; 7 + 13 review dimensions from the two published rubrics, mapped to 57 sections, every one resolving

图纸文字越界与压字 — overflow: 0 overrun(s) across 107 sheets in 4 sets (svg, svg.en, sheets, sheets.en) — these are build-side SVG sources, not in the package; what ships is the rendered result, checkable by opening the PNGs and the two PDFs
双语内容一致性 — bilingual content parity: overall 87%, 15/15 sections at or above floor

scarce_surface_qa.py — scarce surface: the one rasterised board carries identity, kit-of-parts, neither of which is among the 5 figures the harness sends on its own (read from upstream/main); 6 boards in all

stale_corpus_qa.py — stale corpus sizes: none — 18 superseded readings (184–770) appear only inside generated blocks or sentences that declare them historical; the prose is at 793

statute_quote_qa.py — statute quotes: 4 quotation(s) from 3 statutes, every one appearing verbatim in the text the organisers ship (read from upstream/main) and still present in the proposal
